secondSeedPolicy: Train the validation-selected configuration again with seed 1729. Report both test runs. Never select a seed on test accuracy.
fewShotExamples: Five fixed training IDs are recorded in the frozen dataset manifest before inference.
mcnemar: Exact two-sided binomial test on paired severity correctness. Invalid schema is incorrect. Report discordant counts.
publicSourceSlice: Keep source provenance and assistant rubric labels. Never describe source notes as the author's walk or assistant labels as independent human ground truth.
tabpfnDecisionRule: TabPFN is shown in the Lab as useful only if its AUC beats logistic regression at n <= 128.
tabpfnDecisionImplementation: Mean paired AUC difference must be positive at all three sizes 32, 64 and 128. Report uncertainty even when this descriptive rule passes.
tabpfnConfidenceInterval: Two-sided Student t interval across five training repeats. The same fixed 500 test rows are reused. This does not include test-population uncertainty.
